name: appworld_react30_c20480_r129600
source: AppWorld ReAct protocol (30 turns, 20,480-token context) with milestones every 14,400 generated rollouts
reward: strict terminal binary; no overlong shaping

eval.selection: dev avg@3 during training (in_training_dev_interval steps) and at the final checkpoint; earliest step on ties
eval.test: test_normal and test_challenge, 3 decodes (decode d: seed 20260826+d), h=0, on the final checkpoint and the dev-selected one only

setup_fields.budget_definition: 90 train tasks * 16 trajectories * 90 data epochs; includes all filtered groups; excludes evaluation
setup_fields.actor_partial_batch: flush tail with actual global student-token denominator
setup_fields.update_units: collector cycle: up to 32 groups; Adam step: up to 32 trajectory samples; log both
setup_fields.checkpoint_policy: save due every 5 cycles; defer until pending pools are empty, latest 1 retained

reliable_rpc.server_crash_policy: fail closed; never replay uncertain state
